records.prompt: Correct the attack animation of this Russian mail spearman. Output a 1536x1024 transparent RGBA sprite atlas, 3columns x2rows six512x512 cells. Reference1 establishes appearance; reference2 is REJECTED because the HAND SLIDES ALONG THE SPEAR while spear stays still. Fix that specific error. Hand NEVER slides on shaft: a small dark leather grip band remains INSIDE THE SAME CLOSED FIST throughout. FIST AND SPEAR ARE ONE RIGID MOVING ASSEMBLY. The spear BUTT, SHAFT, GRIP and TIP translate screen DOWN together during forward drive. Rear shaft length from fist to capped butt is120px in EVERY FRAME; forward shaft/blade from fist to tip180px in EVERY FRAME. Entire spear length300px, shaft straight, point screenDOWN. No change of grip, no tip stuck in same place, no pulling the hand along shaft. Overhand right fist with knuckles upward throughout, raised elbow opens into extension. Shield held left hand SCREEN RIGHT. Same approved conical iron helmet, silver ringmail, burgundy padding, leather gloves/boots. Directly90degreeOVERHEAD, helmetcrown and shouldertops, consistent200pxbody,100pxhelmet, stable head at256,200. EACH CELL EXACT GEOMETRY, all weaponpoints at x150: frame1READY handy200 butt80 tip380; frame2COCKBACK handy160 butt40 tip340; frame3DRIVE handy230 butt110 tip410; frame4FULLTHRUST handy290 butt170 tip470; frame5WITHDRAW handy230 butt110 tip410; frame6READY handy200 butt80 tip380. At full thrust frame4 there must be120pixels of wood ABOVE the fist and180pixels spear BELOW fist; NOT a fist next to spearbutt. Visible elbow extends forward, spear tip travels130px screenDOWN between2and4. All6completeactors AND weaponinsideeachcell, transparent40pxguards, no spill. Painterly detailed same materials, no thick cartoonoutline, no background,text,shadows. Grounded normal thrust with planted feet.
records.rejection: Hand still slides along spear during windup.
